title: MojoBPF project manifest
description: Structural contract for the TOML project manifest: required tables, value types, name shapes and absolute size bounds. Unknown fields are rejected. Profile-subset narrowing (accepted profiles, program types, sections, map vocabularies, entry counts, CO-RE) is enforced by the build driver against its target-profile registry, not by this schema.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version; this driver reads version 1 only.

name.description: Project name; letters, digits, underscores, dots and dashes, starting with a letter, digit or underscore.

profile.description: Target profile identifier; membership is checked against the driver registry.

core.description: Whether CO-RE relocations are requested; support depends on the named profile.

name.description: Output object name; same shape as the project name.

source_license.description: SPDX expression for the program sources.

kernel_license.description: Explicit ELF license declaration; never silently replaced.

programs.description: Programs built into the single output object; at least one entry is required.

source.description: Mojo source path relative to the manifest file; absolute paths and escapes outside the manifest directory are rejected.

entry.description: Exported entry symbol; C identifier shape; unique within the manifest.

program_type.description: BPF program type; accepted pairs depend on the named profile.

section.description: ELF section; accepted pairs depend on the named profile.

maps.description: Map declarations; may be omitted when the programs use no maps.

name.description: Map name; C identifier shape; unique within the manifest.

map_type.description: Map type name; accepted vocabulary depends on the named profile.

key_type.description: Key scalar type; accepted vocabulary depends on the named profile.

value_type.description: Value scalar type; accepted vocabulary depends on the named profile.

max_entries.description: Absolute structural bound for the 32-bit entry-count field; the named profile may narrow it further.
